_comment: The vol 10 cast as hero slots for the Meshy pipeline. Each entry is one text-to-3D generation (Meshy) → GLB installed via godot/tools/hero_uploader/ into godot/assets/3d/characters/heroes/ under 'file' → instanced by build_strip_panel.py per staging job. 'meshy_prompt' is the text-to-3D brief; 'texture_prompt' the Meshy texturing pass. One model per age; expressions come from pose + camera + the comic's own ink, not from the mesh. NOTE (the authorial rule): there is no 'arthur' hero. Wood is the character; the author is never staged. comic_look: the strip's own description per era (from lore/drift_wood/style/characters.md); the comic prompt builder uses it, ahead of the meshy_prompt, so a character's look on the page is the strip's, not the 3D model's.

extra_framer.name: THE FRAMER
extra_framer.who: SLASH (2001–03): the frame shop's framer, who isn't Wood and has Wood's hands
extra_framer.comic_identity: a man of forty with heavy-lidded eyes, a barber's mustache and a long jaw, hair combed back; ink-stained hands that are exactly Wood's, drawn the same
extra_framer.comic_wardrobe: a shop apron over a white shirt with the sleeves rolled; street shoes wrong for a boat

extra_green_coat.name: THE GREEN COAT
extra_green_coat.who: SLASH: the woman with the photograph she won't let the framer see
extra_green_coat.comic_identity: a woman in her thirties, tall, a hat brim low, a mouth drawn as one flat line; mostly her back and her gloved hands; the coat is green and the page is black and white, so it reads as the darkest shape on the page
extra_green_coat.comic_wardrobe: a long green wool coat (drawn as the darkest black), leather gloves, a hat with a brim

extra_sergeant.name: THE DESK SERGEANT
extra_sergeant.who: SLASH: the Newport police's desk sergeant, a shoulder at the frame's edge
extra_sergeant.comic_identity: a broad shoulder and a jaw at the frame's edge, a uniform's patch drawn blank; never a whole face

extra_stranger.name: THE STRANGER
extra_stranger.who: THE FRONTIER WEEK (Small Wood, 1871): the stranger on a mule whose name is the town's
extra_stranger.comic_identity: a lean man under a hat brim pulled low, three days' stubble, a long jaw; a small dog trots beside him
extra_stranger.comic_wardrobe: a long duster to the boot, a low-crowned hat, a bandana
extra_stranger.comic_props: a mule; a card in his hatband, face down

extra_lapels.name: THE MAN WHO SMOOTHS HIS LAPELS
extra_lapels.who: a riverboat gambler in THE FRONTIER WEEK (2000), the man at Table 14 in THE SINKHOLE (2003) and on the motel TV in THE POMEGRANATE HOUR (2013): the same figure, quoted from another volume, never named
extra_lapels.comic_identity: a trim man in his fifties with slicked silver hair, a narrow smile and a habit of smoothing both lapels with both hands between everything he does; looks at the camera once
extra_lapels.comic_wardrobe: a good dark suit or a gambler's good coat, a watch chain

extra_painter.name: THE SIGN PAINTER
extra_painter.who: THE FRONTIER WEEK: the painter on the ladder with one letter left
extra_painter.comic_identity: a thin man with a brush in his teeth and paint on his knuckles

extra_surveyor.name: THE SURVEYOR
extra_surveyor.who: THE FRONTIER WEEK: the surveyor whose map doesn't have the stone face
extra_surveyor.comic_identity: a stout man with a chain over his shoulder and a stake in his fist, sure of his map
extra_surveyor.comic_props: a surveyor's chain; a stake; a map

extra_mill_boss.name: THE MILL BOSS
extra_mill_boss.who: THE FRONTIER WEEK: the sawmill boss in shirtsleeves
extra_mill_boss.comic_identity: a thick man with a beard and rolled sleeves, gestures at ten thousand stumps

extra_bartender.name: THE BARTENDER
extra_bartender.who: THE SINKHOLE's diner bartender behind the well since '83 (2003), and the bar in THE LONG WAY BACK (2010): turned away, wiping a glass
extra_bartender.comic_identity: a heavy man seen mostly from behind, bald crown, a white towel over one shoulder, never looks at the stool
extra_bartender.comic_wardrobe: a white shirt, a black vest

extra_helmsman.name: THE HELMSMAN
extra_helmsman.who: THE SINKHOLE: the man at the riverboat's wheel who doesn't let go
extra_helmsman.comic_identity: a hatless man with both hands on a wheel as the deck tilts, face set

extra_diner_dog.name: THE DINER DOG
extra_diner_dog.who: THE SINKHOLE: a dog asleep under a booth, not the strip's dog
extra_diner_dog.comic_identity: a low brown dog asleep under a booth, no breed the strip names

extra_host.name: THE HOST
extra_host.who: THE POMEGRANATE HOUR, 3 AM: the talk-show host at a table with a cassette deck, drawn in three strokes
extra_host.comic_identity: a woman of forty with a dark bob and a stillness, drawn in three strokes: the bob, the shoulders, the hand on the deck
extra_host.comic_wardrobe: a dark blouse, a brass-railed set behind her
extra_host.comic_props: a cassette deck; a phone handset

extra_lean_man.name: THE LEAN MAN
extra_lean_man.who: THE LONG WAY BACK, stop XV: the lean man at the far end of the bar who looks back
extra_lean_man.comic_identity: a lean man in a good jacket at a bar's far end, the only face in the sequence that looks straight at the viewer

extra_logger.name: THE LOGGER
extra_logger.who: CEDAR: the logger at a tailgate, certain about the slash pile
extra_logger.comic_identity: a big man with a gray beard and a coffee, pointing up with the cup
extra_logger.comic_wardrobe: a hickory shirt, suspenders, a hard hat on the tailgate

extra_ring_woman.name: THE WOMAN WHO WAS A TREE
extra_ring_woman.who: CEDAR: the woman at the chained mill gate who remembers the year she was a cedar; drawn in cutaway with rings inside her, one ring notched
extra_ring_woman.comic_identity: a woman of sixty with a long gray plait and a face like bark, crouched to a dog; in cutaway her torso is tree rings with one notched
extra_ring_woman.comic_wardrobe: a canvas work coat, rubber boots

extra_listener.name: THE LISTENER
extra_listener.who: CEDAR: the man with a stethoscope to a cedar round, eyes closed
extra_listener.comic_identity: a thin man of seventy with his eyes closed and a stethoscope pressed to wood, a knife in his other hand
extra_listener.comic_wardrobe: a wool coat, a knit cap

extra_family.name: THE FAMILY
extra_family.who: CEDAR: the family at the table with the trunk at its head
extra_family.comic_identity: a mother, a father and two children eating around a cedar trunk, unbothered; ordinary faces the page keeps ordinary

locales_needed._comment: Blender locale builds not yet written (godot/tools/blender/locales/build_<name>.py → godot/assets/3d/locales/<name>.glb). build_strip_panel.py falls back to a bare ground plane when the GLB is missing, so heroes can be staged before sets exist.
locales_needed.dw_cafeteria: Small Wood High cafeteria: long tables, the serving line, a wall of windows onto rain
locales_needed.dw_timberline_newsroom: the school paper's room: two desks pushed together, a dark window, a light table
locales_needed.dw_newport_lot: the coast community college parking lot in rain: a Datsun, a sign for Lot C
locales_needed.dw_laundromat: the laundromat: dryers, a folding table, the free rack by the door (Pizza Pirate's back-hall door beside it, unmarked)
locales_needed.dw_frame_shop: Heceta Frame & Matting: the backroom mat-cutting table, foam core, the rain alley with spackle buckets out the side door
locales_needed.dw_garage: the garage apartment behind the tavern: drafting table with swing-arm lamp, casement window on the gravel alley, cinderblock bookcase, banker's boxes, the dog bed under the table, porch with cedar steps and an aluminum storm door
locales_needed.dw_gullys: Gully's Tackle & Roast: shingle shack, counter with a two-group espresso machine and bait cooler, corkboard above the register, the dock out back on pilings
locales_needed.dw_motel_desk: the Driftwood Motel night-audit desk: CRT, bell, key rack, the ice machine down the hall
locales_needed.dw_greyhound: the Greyhound stop on 101: a bench, a tinted-window bus, Sitka spruce, the serpentine bend
locales_needed.dw_pavilion_dock: the San Juan Islands wedding: a cedar-and-glass pavilion, the dock at night with the reception glowing behind
locales_needed.dw_mudflats: Alsea Bay mudflats at low tide: bleached drift cedar, gulls, the bay mouth
locales_needed.dw_bowling_alley: Small Wood Lanes from across the highway at night: the neon sign, the lot, the dumpster behind
locales_needed.dw_library_back_room: the library's back room: archive boxes, an empty chair, reading-room glass
